name: huntay-azerturk
description: Check Huntay AzerTürk's availability, book a 30-minute intro call, and look up his services.

interface.longDescription:
Huntay AzerTürk is a software architect and engineering leader in Istanbul who works with companies on software architecture, AI agents, cloud and IoT. This plugin connects ChatGPT to his live booking calendar and to the public content of huntayazerturk.com.

What you can do:
- See his open times for a 30-minute intro video call (Google Meet) in your own time zone. Times are read live from his calendar (Monday to Friday, 10:00–18:00 Istanbul time).
- Book an intro call: choose a time, share your name and email, confirm, and the calendar invitation is emailed to you. Nothing is booked until you confirm.
- Describe your project and see which of his services fit, with what each one includes.
- Look up his profile, case studies, FAQ, work experience and articles, with links to the source pages.

Works in English and Turkish. No account or sign-in is needed. Your name, email and optional notes are sent to the scheduling provider (Cal.com) only when you book; conversations are not stored. Privacy policy: https://huntayazerturk.com/privacy
defaultPrompt: When is Huntay AzerTürk free for an intro call next week?
Which of Huntay AzerTürk's services fits an AI support agent project?
Show me Huntay AzerTürk's case study about an IoT cloud platform.

positive.description: Show open times in the user's time zone
positive.prompt: When is Huntay AzerTürk available for a 30-minute intro call next week? I'm in Berlin.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_availability with timeZone Europe/Berlin and shows the open 30-minute slots for next week's weekdays in Berlin time (within Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 Istanbul time) in a card. If no slot is open in that range, it says so and suggests later dates. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: Book an intro call only after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Book an intro call with Huntay AzerTürk at the earliest open time next week. My name is Jordan Lee, my email is huntay.azerturk+review@gmail.com, and I want to talk about an AI agent for our support team.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_availability, proposes the earliest open slot and summarizes the time, time zone, name, email and topic, then asks the user to confirm. Only after the user confirms (for example "Yes, book it") does it call book_intro_call; it then shows a confirmation card with the booked date and time and says the calendar invitation with the Google Meet link was emailed to huntay.azerturk+review@gmail.com. Use this deliverable test address: the scheduler rejects undeliverable domains such as example.com. Test bookings are cancelled by the developer.

positive.description: Match services to the user's need and explain the match
positive.prompt: We're a SaaS startup and want an AI agent to answer customer support tickets. Which of Huntay AzerTürk's services fits, and what does it include?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_services with the user's need; AI Agents & Automation is returned as the match with a short reason. Then calls get_service with slug ai-agents and summarizes who it is for, its deliverables and use cases, with a link to https://huntayazerturk.com/services/ai-agents. It does not invent services, prices or results that the tools did not return.

positive.prompt: Who is Huntay AzerTürk and what is his background?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_profile and shows a profile card: a software architect and engineering leader based in Istanbul who works remotely in English or Turkish, his focus areas (software architecture, AI, cloud, IoT), career highlights and links to his website. Facts come only from the tool output.

positive.description: Find and open a case study
positive.prompt: Find Huntay AzerTürk's case study about a large IoT cloud platform and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search (for example with "IoT cloud"), then fetch with the id case-study:iot-cloud, and summarizes the multi-platform IoT cloud case study (10,000+ devices, 100,000+ users), including the approach and the result, with its source URL on huntayazerturk.com.

negative.description: Unrelated booking request. The plugin should not be used: ChatGPT answers without calling any Huntay AzerTürk tool.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant in Rome tonight.

negative.description: Missing details and no confirmation. book_intro_call must not be called: the assistant may show open times, then asks for a preferred time, the user's name and email, and an explicit confirmation before booking.
negative.prompt: Just book any time with Huntay AzerTürk for me.

negative.description: Unsupported action. The plugin cannot cancel or change meetings: no booking is created or changed, and the assistant explains that an attendee can reschedule or cancel their own booking with the link in the confirmation email.
negative.prompt: Cancel all of Huntay AzerTürk's meetings this week.

review.commerce_description: No products are sold and no payments are processed. Booking an intro call has no payment step.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live availability and booking of a 30-minute intro call, service matching and details, profile, and search and fetch over case studies, FAQ, work experience and articles. Works in English and Turkish.

tr-TR.subtitle: Randevu al, hizmetleri incele
tr-TR.description:
Huntay AzerTürk, İstanbul'da şirketlerle yazılım mimarisi, yapay zeka ajanları, bulut ve IoT üzerine çalışan bir yazılım mimarı ve mühendislik lideridir. Bu eklenti ChatGPT'yi onun canlı randevu takvimine ve huntayazerturk.com'un herkese açık içeriğine bağlar.

Neler yapabilirsiniz:
- 30 dakikalık tanışma görüşmesi (Google Meet) için boş saatlerini kendi saat diliminizde görün. Saatler canlı olarak takviminden okunur (hafta içi 10:00–18:00, İstanbul saati).
- Tanışma görüşmesi planlayın: bir saat seçin, adınızı ve e-postanızı paylaşın, onaylayın; takvim daveti e-postanıza gelir. Siz onaylamadan randevu oluşturulmaz.
- Projenizi anlatın; hangi hizmetlerinin uygun olduğunu ve her birinin neleri kapsadığını görün.
- Profiline, vaka çalışmalarına, SSS'ye, iş deneyimine ve yazılarına kaynak sayfa bağlantılarıyla ulaşın.

Türkçe ve İngilizce çalışır. Hesap veya giriş gerekmez. Adınız, e-postanız ve isteğe bağlı notlarınız yalnızca randevu aldığınızda randevu sağlayıcısına (Cal.com) iletilir; sohbetler saklanmaz. Gizlilik politikası: https://huntayazerturk.com/tr/privacy
